# Shopify Change Intelligence

> Monitor any public Shopify store. Free live snapshot; paid change intelligence and competitor reports in USDC via x402 on Base.

- Endpoint (MCP, Streamable HTTP): https://shopify-intel.contentforge-press.workers.dev/mcp
- Free snapshot: https://shopify-intel.contentforge-press.workers.dev/v1/snapshot?store=allbirds.com
- x402 discovery: https://shopify-intel.contentforge-press.workers.dev/.well-known/x402
- Embed a free store widget: https://shopify-intel.contentforge-press.workers.dev/embed

## Tools (MCP)
- shopify_snapshot: free live catalog snapshot (product count, price range, stock)
- shopify_changes: $0.05 — new/removed products, price moves, restock/out-of-stock vs history
- shopify_intel_report: $0.50 — full-catalog competitor report with takeaways
- shopify_batch_watch: $0.03 per store — watch up to 50 stores in one call
- shopify_landscape: $5 — strategic competitive landscape across up to 10 stores

Paid tools settle USDC on Base using x402; no API key or account needed to discover or call.
